data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard
High-cost drugs represent a significant proportion of NHS prescribing expenditure and require careful monitoring. The High Cost Drugs Report at practice level provides detailed insights into prescribing patterns and associated costs for medicines excluded from the national tariff. It enables practices to review usage, validate claims, and ensure compliance with commissioning arrangements.

The report supports financial accountability by highlighting expenditure on high-cost items and identifying opportunities for optimisation. It also assists practices in aligning prescribing with local and national guidance, reducing unwarranted variation and improving patient outcomes.

The aim of this report is to help practices manage high-cost prescribing effectively, ensuring that resources are used appropriately and equitably. It should be used alongside other financial and clinical reports to provide a complete picture of prescribing behaviour and cost impact.
